journey.name: settings defaults after wallet wipe
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable, unfunded wallet without a PIN, on an English device, using an E2E_BUILD app with the local regtest backend from journeys/README.md. The default Electrum endpoint is 127.0.0.1:60001 and must also be reachable as localhost:60001. Start with no custom server setting. This deletes the wallet. Keep Bitkit running throughout so the settings singleton survives the reset.

actions.action: Open Settings, select Advanced (id "Tab-advanced"), and verify Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig") shows Auto
Open Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig"), change Host (id "HostInput") to "localhost", keep port 60001 and TCP, and tap Connect (id "ConnectToHost")
Wait for the successful connection and verify the connected server (id "Connected") reads "localhost:60001"
Return to Advanced settings and verify Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig") shows "localhost"
Open Rapid-Gossip-Sync (id "RGSServer") and record the default URL shown by id "ConnectedUrl"
Change only the hostname in the URL (id "RGSUrl") to uppercase, keeping the scheme and path unchanged, and tap Connect (id "ConnectToHost")
Wait for the successful update toast (id "RgsUpdatedToast"), return to Advanced settings, reopen Rapid-Gossip-Sync, and verify the changed URL is still saved
Return to Advanced settings
Select Security (id "Tab-security") and turn on Read Clipboard (id "AutoReadClipboard")
Turn off Swipe Balance to Hide (id "SwipeBalanceToHide") and verify both toggles show the chosen values
Open PIN Code (id "PINCode"), tap Enable PIN (id "EnablePin"), enter "1234", and enter "1234" again to confirm
Leave biometrics off and tap Continue; if the Phone Settings screen appears instead, tap Skip (id "SkipButton")
On Wallet Secured, turn on Also require for payments (id "ToggleBioForPayments") and tap OK
Verify PIN Code (id "PINCode") shows Enabled and Require PIN for payments (id "EnablePinForPayments") is on
Open Reset wallet (id "ResetAndRestore"), tap Reset Wallet, and confirm the reset
Wait for Terms of Use, tap Continue, tap Skip Intro, and tap New Wallet (id "NewWallet")
Wait for Home without a prompt for the old PIN; if offered security setup for the new wallet, tap Later
Open Settings and select Security (id "Tab-security")
Verify Read Clipboard (id "AutoReadClipboard") is off and Swipe Balance to Hide (id "SwipeBalanceToHide") is on
Verify PIN Code (id "PINCode") shows Disabled and Require PIN for payments (id "EnablePinForPayments") is absent
Select Advanced (id "Tab-advanced") and verify Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig") shows Auto before opening the server screen
Open Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig") and verify Host (id "HostInput") is "127.0.0.1", Port (id "PortInput") is "60001", TCP is selected, and no loading indicator remains
Return to Advanced settings and open Rapid-Gossip-Sync (id "RGSServer")
Verify the connected URL (id "ConnectedUrl") and URL field (id "RGSUrl") match the original default recorded before the wipe, and no loading indicator remains
Change only the hostname in the URL (id "RGSUrl") to uppercase again, tap Connect (id "ConnectToHost"), and wait for the successful update toast (id "RgsUpdatedToast")
Return to Advanced settings, open Electrum Server (id "ElectrumConfig"), change Host (id "HostInput") to "localhost", keep port 60001 and TCP, and tap Connect (id "ConnectToHost")
Wait for the successful connection and verify the connected server (id "Connected") reads "localhost:60001" with no loading indicator remaining
